newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - December 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - December 20.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's edition of Daily Variety:

WASHINGTON - Almost 30 years after creating the movie industry's content code, MPAA president Jack Valenti completed a historic repeat performance by officially presenting the new TV ratings system to President Clinton at the White House Thursday.
HOLLYWOOD - Indie distribs and biopics dominated the 54th annual Golden Globe nominations, as Disney-owned Miramax's The English Patient led the roster with seven bids.

NEW YORK - Barry Diller's Silver King Communications will Friday complete its acquisition of Home Shopping Network Inc, allowing Diller to move to the next stage in his plan to create a new programming service from Silver King's TV station group.
HOLLYWOOD - Marcello Mastroianni, the suave but humorous Italian actor who starred in landmark Federico Fellini films and dozens of romantic comedies, has died.

HOLLYWOOD - Mark S. Lieberman is joining Cahners Publishing Co as executive vice president, entertainment, communications and media, where he will spearhead an aggressive programme of acquisition and development, it was announced by Bruce Barnet, president and chief executive officer.
